sources.snippet: General Electric Company, doing business as GE Aerospace, is an American aircraft engine supplier that is headquartered in Evendale, Ohio, outside Cincinnati. It is the legal successor to the original
GE Aerospace both manufactures engines under its name and partners with other manufacturers to produce engines. CFM International, the world's leading
GE Aerospace supplier portal provides suppliers the ability to access information and enter business transactions in an online and secure environment.
